name: Triangle: Weakside Flash
idea: When the top is denied, a teammate flashes to the high post and the denied player cuts backdoor.
why: A defender who jumps into the passing lane can't see behind them. The flash gives the wing a safe pass, and the top player cuts behind their defender for an easy layup. Coaches call this the blind pig.
tryit: Opposite: when you see the top being denied, sprint to the high post with your hands up. Top player: wait for the catch, then cut backdoor behind your defender.

frames.say: {X3} jumps into the passing lane, so {2} can't pass to {3} at the top.
*Weakside flash:* {4} sprints up to the high post to get open.
{2} passes to {4} at the high post.
{X3} is still guarding the pass, so {3} cuts *backdoor* behind {X3}, straight to the hoop.
Layup! When your defender jumps into the passing lane, cut behind them.
